lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਨ ਕਿਉ ਸੋਇਆ ਤੂ ਨੀਦ ਭਰੇ ਜਾਗਤ ਕਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: raajan kiu soiaa too need bhare jaagat kat naahee raam ||
lines.translation: O king, why are you sleeping? Why don't you wake up to reality?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਝੂਠੁ ਰੁਦਨੁ ਕੇਤੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa jhooth rudan kete bilalaahee raam ||
lines.translation: It is useless to cry and whine about Maya, but so many cry out and bewail.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਲਾਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilalaahi kete mahaa mohan bin naam har ke sukh nahee ||
lines.translation: So many cry out for Maya, the great enticer, but without the Name of the Lord, there is no peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਉਪਾਵ ਥਾਕੇ ਜਹ ਭਾਵਤ ਤਹ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahas siaanap upaav thaake jah bhaavat tah jaahee ||
lines.translation: Thousands of clever tricks and efforts will not succeed. One goes wherever the Lord wills him to go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aad a(n)te madh pooran sarabatr ghat ghat aahee ||
lines.translation: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is all-pervading everywhere; He is in each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਮੁ ਸੇ ਪਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak jin saadhasa(n)gam se pat setee ghar jaahee ||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, those who join the Saadh Sangat go to the house of the Lord with honor. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਰਪਤਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਗ੍ਰਹਿਓ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: narapat jaan grahio sevak siaane raam ||
lines.translation: O king of mortals, know that your palaces and wise servants shall be of no use in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਪਰ ਵੀਛੁੜਣਾ ਮੋਹੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarapar veechhuRanaa mohe pachhutaane raam ||
lines.translation: You shall certainly have to separate yourself from them, and their attachment shall make you feel regret.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਕਹਾ ਅਸਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: haricha(n)dauree dekh bhoolaa kahaa asathit paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Beholding the phantom city, you have gone astray; how can you now find stability?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਆਨ ਰਚਨਾ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin naam har ke aan rachanaa ahilaa janam gavaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Absorbed in things other than the Name of the Lord, this human life is wasted in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹ ਕਾਂਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਗਿਆਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau hau karat na trisan boojhai nah kaa(n)m pooran giaane ||
lines.translation: Indulging in egotistical actions, your thirst is not quenched. Your desires are not fulfilled, and you do not attain spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਕੇਤਿਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak bin naam har ke ketiaa pachhutaane ||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, without the Name of the Lord, so many have departed with regret. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੋ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaar anugraho apanaa kar leenaa raam ||
lines.translation: Showering His blessings, the Lord has made me His own.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੁਜਾ ਗਹਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਓ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhujaa gahi kaadh leeo saadhoo sa(n)g deenaa raam ||
lines.translation: Grasping me by the arm, He has pulled me out of the mud, and He has blessed me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਸਗਲ ਕਲਮਲ ਦੁਖ ਜਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gam har araadhe sagal kalamal dukh jale ||
lines.translation: Worshipping the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, all my sins and sufferings are burnt away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਦਾਨ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੇ ਚਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa dharam sudaan kiriaa sa(n)g terai se chale ||
lines.translation: This is the greatest religion, and the best act of charity; this alone shall go along with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਅਰਾਧੈ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa araadhai ek suaamee har naam man tan bheenaa ||
lines.translation: My tongue chants in adoration the Name of the One Lord and Master; my mind and body are drenched in the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਬੀਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jis no har milaae so sarab gun parabeenaa ||4||6||9||
lines.translation: O Nanak, whoever the Lord unites with Himself, is filled with all virtues. ||4||6||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਹਾਗੜੇ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: bihaagaRe kee vaar mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Vaar Of Bihaagraa, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa te sukh paaeeai hor thai sukh na bhaal ||
lines.translation: Serving the Guru, peace is obtained; do not search for peace anywhere else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੇਦੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad man bhedeeai sadaa vasai har naal ||
lines.translation: The soul is pierced by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. The Lord dwells ever with the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam tinaa kau milai jin har vekhai nadar nihaal ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they alone obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord, who are blessed by the Lord with His Glance of Grace. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੈ ਸੋ ਖਰਚੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: siphat khajaanaa bakhas hai jis bakhasai so kharachai khaai ||
lines.translation: The treasure of the Lord's Praise is such a blessed gift; he alone obtains it to spend, unto whom the Lord bestows it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਸਭ ਥਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bin hath na aavaee sabh thake karam kamaai ||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, it does not come to hand; all have grown weary of performing religious rituals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਧਨਹੀਣੁ ਹੈ ਅਗੈ ਭੁਖਾ ਕਿ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak manamukh jagat dhanaheen hai agai bhukhaa k khaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs of the world lack this wealth; when they are hungry in the next world, what will they have to eat there? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਸਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh teree too sabhas daa sabh tudh upaaiaa ||
lines.translation: All are Yours, and You belong to all. You created all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੂ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਤੂ ਸਭਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa vich too varatadaa too sabhanee dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: You are pervading within all - all meditate on You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਤੂ ਭਗਤਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis dee too bhagat thaai paaihi jo tudh man bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: You accept the devotional worship of those who are pleasing to Your Mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo har prabh bhaavai so theeai sabh karan teraa karaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases the Lord God happens; all act as You cause them to act.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇ ਵਡਾ ਜੋ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: salaahihu har sabhanaa te vadaa jo sa(n)t janaa(n) kee paij rakhadaa aaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Praise the Lord, the greatest of all; He preserves the honor of the Saints. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਜਗਿ ਜੀਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak giaanee jag jeetaa jag jeetaa sabh koi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the spiritually wise one has conquered all others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naame kaaraj sidh hai sahaje hoi s hoi ||
lines.translation: Through the Name, his affairs are brought to perfection; whatever happens is by His Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਅਚਲੁ ਹੈ ਚਲਾਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat mat achal hai chalaai na sakai koi ||
lines.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, his mind is held steady; no one can make him waver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagataa kaa har a(n)geekaar kare kaaraj suhaavaa hoi ||
lines.translation: The Lord makes His devotee His own, and his affairs are adjusted.
